description: Source code for generating support packets in Mattermost, including diagnostics, configuration, profiling, and external service detection.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service class providing support packet generation and diagnostics functions.

methods.name: GenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Generates a support packet with diagnostics, config, profiles, and logs based on options.

methods.name: getSupportPacketDiagnostics
methods.description: Collects system, database, LDAP, SAML, Elasticsearch, and cluster diagnostics into a YAML file.

methods.name: getSanitizedConfigFile
methods.description: Returns a sanitized JSON configuration file.

methods.name: getCPUProfile
methods.description: Generates a CPU profile and returns it as a file.

methods.name: getHeapProfile
methods.description: Generates a heap profile and returns it as a file.

methods.name: getGoroutineProfile
methods.description: Generates a goroutine profile and returns it as a file.

methods.name: detectSAMLProviderType
methods.description: Identifies the SAML provider type based on the IdpDescriptorURL.
